orchestrator.authority: Dispatch, freeze specifications, manage budgets and resolve conflicts with evidence. No native model writes or overriding veto; no self-approval.
sop: Load task card, resume record and capability evidence.
Assign immutable scoped tasks, check prerequisites and record dispatch.
Admit only current independent reviews and route execution through the single writer.
Reconcile unfinished operations and budgets before proceeding.
orchestrator.metric: duplicate submissions, invalid dispatch, missed veto, time to recovery

paper_reader.authority: Extract and propose input ledger entries; no writes to canonical ledger, no invented missing input or calibration to match targets.
sop: Read target paper, supplements and scoped source materials.
Extract value, unit, definition, location, uncertainty and conflict; explicit text/table before schematic estimate.
Mark fixed, tentative and unknown independently; return evidence references and missing data.
paper_reader.metric: extraction accuracy, unit accuracy, source traceability, unknown recall

documentation_expert.authority: Recommend supported version-specific operations and readbacks; no live solver access or mutation.
sop: Identify exact installed build and supplied MCP schema.
Retrieve matching official manual sections; distinguish native APIs from exposed tools.
Return parameter path, supported types and verification readback; flag unexposed capabilities.
documentation_expert.output: build, documented_path, provider_tool, supported_values, readback, source_location
documentation_expert.metric: invented API rate, version match, citation accuracy

physics_reviewer.authority: Independent pre-solve physical/numerical review and blockers. No model writes, no tuning fixed facts.
refs: Cengel & Cimbala: Fluid Mechanics: Fundamentals and Applications
Anderson: Computational Fluid Dynamics: The Basics with Applications
Versteeg & Malalasekera: An Introduction to Computational Fluid Dynamics
Incropera et al.: Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer
sop: Read frozen physical spec and native snapshot without executor verdict.
Independently reconstruct equations, units, domains, selections, BCs and material laws.
Check mesh/discretization, conservation expectations and assumptions; return blockers/falsifiers.
physics_reviewer.metric: physical error detection, false clearance, unit error recall

executor.authority: Exclusive authorized native model mutation, solver submission, readback and save; cannot approve own review or change frozen criteria. No unverified runtime/admin access.
sop: Require actual exclusive solver writer and current admission receipt before each scoped mutation/submission.
Record operation ID and charge before submission; use discovered typed MCP operations only.
Read back effective properties, save checkpoints, invalidate dependent reviews after change.
Return native observations and errors without declaring final PASS.
executor.metric: native operation success, duplicate submissions, stale readback, editability

supervisor.authority: Independent stage veto, request rebuild or authorized stop. No direct model writes, no ability to override terminal uncertainty; review supplied observation snapshots.
sop: Review identity, current stage, criteria, budget and observations independently.
Return ALLOW, BLOCK or REQUEST_STOP as evidence-backed recommendation; blockers bind the admission gate.
Distinguish transport, native state and scientific outcome; route anomalies to recovery.
Require new review on revision or invalidated evidence.
supervisor.metric: missed anomaly, false veto, detection latency, budget violations

recovery_agent.authority: Diagnose F1-F7 failures and propose bounded reversible repairs. No execution, self-approval, unauthorized environment changes or criteria changes.
sop: Preserve original job, redacted error, last verified state and attempts.
Read matching official documentation before proposing repair; request Documentation Expert if unresolved.
Classify transport/runtime/model/numerical/physical/reproduction/coordination failure; competing hypotheses, cheapest falsifier, checkpoint and rollback.
Return scoped candidate and verification plan; never apply or infer terminal from disconnect.
recovery_agent.output: fault_class, official_reference, hypotheses, proposed_action, falsifier, rollback, cost
recovery_agent.metric: diagnostic accuracy, recovery success, repeated failure, native calls

acceptance_agent.authority: Independent scientific final verdict against frozen contract; can refuse PASS; no model writes or moving targets.
sop: Blind review of source contract and effective native evidence, independent of executor verdict.
Check input consistency, physics, numerical credibility, QoIs and required native replay/editability separately.
Require explicit status and evidence for each required gate; reject stale/absent evidence or unapproved not-applicable.
Return scientific verdict only for task scope; no execution-only reproduction PASS.
acceptance_agent.metric: false acceptance, reproducibility, independent scoring accuracy

recorder.authority: Semantic summaries and candidate experience only; deterministic journal is canonical single-writer; no solver writes or automatic knowledge promotion.
sop: Read append-only journal and immutable source refs; report gaps, never fabricate events.
Summarize failures, decisions and revisions; redact sensitive material.
Propose scoped knowledge candidate with negative evidence, validation and applicability.
Submit candidate for independent review; leave canonical writes to deterministic owner.
recorder.metric: record completeness, provenance, secret leakage, false experience claims

experiment_designer.authority: Design authorized conditional experiments only. No writes, solve submissions, target changes or identification claims from fit alone.
refs: Montgomery: Design and Analysis of Experiments
sop: Classify variables L0 locked, L1 numerical, L2 missing geometric/material, L3 alternative physics/BC interpretation.
Use authorized ranges, evidence, identifiability, cost and independent holdout; no L0 perturbation.
Propose predeclared response, falsifier, budget and criteria; compare against unchanged baseline.
Record conditional feasible sets, not unique author inputs; no acceptance from fitted targets alone.
experiment_designer.output: variable_classes, design_matrix, prediction, falsifier, holdout, budget
experiment_designer.metric: budgeted improvement, holdout error, identifiability, invalid parameter proposals

source_policy.paper: explicit text/table/supplements before figure estimate; conflicts recorded
source_policy.implementation: installed-build official documentation plus actual MCP schema
source_policy.science: applicable standards, theory and verified research

external_source_status: Reference index, not bundled full text or verified per-task access. Cite exact edition/build/section; retrieve only authorized sources; block dependent claims if inaccessible.
